messages:
Alex: Quick customer ask: in Console analytics they want a single-click view that shows per-route token burn broken down by model variant + routing policy. currently it's opaque.

Priya: Agree. For saved queries we should show which routing policy was active when the snapshot was taken (primary only vs primary+compat). otherwise numbers mislead.

Ben: Backend note: we already emit model_id and tokens in telemetry. Missing pieces: routing_policy_at_request and route_config_version. adding those two fields will let frontend reconstruct a breakdown.

Tessa: UX: propose a compact table column "policy" and a tooltip "policy at time of request". Also add a small badge on saved queries like "pinned v42". Clicking allows "update to latest" or "keep pinned".

Alex: +1. Also customers want to see an "estimated billed tokens" column that accounts for sampling and fallbacks. show math in hover: displayed_tokens / sampling_rate * (1 + fallback_penalty).

Ben: Telemetry change list: add route_config_version (int), routing_policy string, sampling_rate (nullable float), and fallback_flag (bool). We'll compress route_config_version as int to keep size down.

Priya: Permissions/ownership: saved queries are team-shared; pinning to a route_version should record user+timestamp in saved_query metadata so experiments are auditable.

infra-bot: ingestion-canary started for telemetry-v2: monitor event-size-p95 and mapping-errors. https://ingest.internal/canaries/telemetry-v2

Tessa: Frontend work: heatmap rows show model variant, policy badge, estimated_billed column, and a drilldown explaining adjustments. I'll post mock in #design by EOD.

Ben: Implementation plan: 1) schema PR to add fields, 2) small producer bump (encode version as int), 3) frontend feature flag behind `analytics_policy_insights`, 4) canary run.

Alex: timeline: mockups today, schema PR tomorrow, canary Friday. if we hit any ingestion alarms we pause.

Priya: one more: when route default sampling is changed we should emit a route_version bump so historical saved queries remain stable.

Alex: Great. Thanks all. We'll reconvene after mocks land.
